Name: (CP) Meg - My dog
Author: xAloneko
Description:
It was supposed to be a spritesheet to be used with Adopt 'n' Skin, but honestly, why not make it a replacer as well? You can still snatch the file and put it in AS, it's even named as Dog_200.png to make it easier. lol

All credits for the base sprite go to spacesheepcaptain, author of the "Yet another dog mod" mod. I just recolored and tweaked one of the sprites to make it look more like Meg.
